mapper.sql: FROM course_offerings o JOIN courses c ON c.id=o.course_id JOIN terms t ON t.id=o.term_id
JOIN offering_members m ON m.offering_id=o.id WHERE m.user_id=#{userId} AND m.role=#{role} AND m.status='active' AND o.term_id=#{termId} AND o.status=#{status}
mapper.select: SELECT id,title,mark FROM courses WHERE status='active' ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses WHERE status='active'
SELECT id,title,mark FROM courses WHERE id=#{id} AND status='active'
SELECT id FROM terms WHERE is_current=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM terms WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id,offering_id,user_id,role,status,joined_at,last_studied_at,last_chapter_id FROM offering_members WHERE offering_id=#{offeringId} AND user_id=#{userId}
SELECT ORDER BY o.created_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT u.id,u.display_name FROM offering_members m JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE m.offering_id=#{offeringId} AND m.role='teacher' AND m.status='active' ORDER BY m.joined_at,m.id

SELECT m.user_id,u.display_name,u.username,m.role,m.joined_at FROM offering_members m JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE m.offering_id=#{offeringId} AND m.status='active' ORDER BY m.created_at DESC,m.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offering_members WHERE offering_id=#{offeringId} AND status='active'
mapper.update: UPDATE course_offerings SET status='archived',updated_at=#{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='active'
mapper.select: SELECT id,offering_id,code_digest,expires_at,max_uses,used_count,revoked_at,created_at,created_by FROM course_invites WHERE offering_id=#{offeringId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_invites WHERE offering_id=#{offeringId}
mapper.update: UPDATE course_invites SET used_count=used_count+1,updated_at=#{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler} WHERE id=#{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler} AND (max_uses IS NULL OR used_count < max_uses)

UPDATE course_invites SET revoked_at=#{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler},updated_at=#{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler} WHERE id=#{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapters WHERE offering_id=#{offeringId} AND status='published' AND is_required=1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapters c JOIN chapter_progress p ON p.chapter_id=c.id AND p.offering_id=c.offering_id WHERE c.offering_id=#{offeringId} AND c.status='published' AND c.is_required=1 AND p.member_id=#{memberId} AND p.status='completed'
